visualCharacteristics: Half image / half text panel. Image position follows authored cell order (image-left or text-left). Text panel: heading, paragraph(s), right-aligned 'Veja mais' link. A text cell with several headings renders as stacked panels beside a full-height image. Option 'dark': ink (#151c21) panel with white text, orange headings and yellow 'Veja mais'. Option 'reverse': mirrors the authored cell order on desktop so the image switches sides without re-authoring; mobile keeps the image on top.
contentPattern: One row, two cells in any order. Image cell: picture. Text cell: heading (H2/H3), paragraph(s), 'Veja mais' link; multiple heading groups become stacked panels.
usage: Home page institutional features: A Copel, Sustentabilidade/Inovacao, Educacao, Mercado livre, Carreira.
reuseGuidance: Use for alternating image + text feature bands. Swap cell order to put the image on the right. Add another heading in the text cell to create an extra stacked panel.
